inlines.v: CONGENER, noun [Latin , kind, race.] A thing of the same kind or nature. The cherry tree has been often grafted on the laurel, to which it is a congener CONGENER, CONGENEROUS, adjective Of the same kind or nature; allied in origin or cause; as congenerous bodies; congenerous diseases.
